name: Manka Peruvian Cuisine
notes: 3 photos: 1 and 2 are the same printed Entrees/Sides page (2 is a closer crop, merged not duplicated); 3 is a Nikkei Bites/Appetizers/Ceviches & Tiraditos/Salads page. Beverage, cocktail, mocktail and beer sections skipped as drink-only. Prices and some descriptions on photo 3's Ceviches & Tiraditos and Salads sections were cropped off the frame and omitted rather than guessed.

dishes.name: Lomo Saltado
dishes.description: Tenderloin sauteed with onion, tomato, aji amarillo, cilantro, tamari, oyster sauce, potatoes, rice.

dishes.name: Arroz con Pato
dishes.description: Duck breast, norteño rice, choclo, carrots, bell peppers, peas, chicha de jora, huancaina sauce and chalaca.

dishes.name: Churrasco a la Peruana
dishes.description: 6oz NY Strip over a Peruvian pesto fettuccine, parmesan cheese, potatoes and huancaina.

dishes.name: Chaufa Manka
dishes.description: Peruvian style fried rice, quinoa, red peppers, scallion, eggs, snap peas, sesame, wonton, ginger, pickled turnips and carrots.

dishes.name: Lamb Chop Quinotto
dishes.description: Grilled New Zealand lamb chops served with quinoa cooked in a risotto style, radish, queso fresco and aji amarillo.

dishes.name: Arroz con Mariscos
dishes.description: Seafood rice with aji amarillo and aji panca, sauteed shrimp, calamari, clams, parmesan cheese, peas, carrot, avocado mousse and chalaca.

dishes.name: Branzino con Choclo Pepian
dishes.description: Grilled branzino, aji amarillo, butter, lemon juice, choclo pepian with onion ash and baby corn.

dishes.name: Tallarines a la Huancaina con Lomo Saltado
dishes.description: Fettuccine with creamy Peruvian yellow pepper sauce served with tenderloin lomo saltado.

dishes.name: Peruvian Style Rib Eye
dishes.description: 14 oz prime ribeye, served with choclo pepian, white rice and a side salad.

dishes.name: Maki Acevichado
dishes.description: Crispy shrimp, yellowfin tuna, avocado, acevichado sauce, sushi rice, crispy sweet potato, aji limo gel and togarashi.

dishes.name: Nigiri Anticuchero
dishes.description: Tenderloin, sushi rice, anticuchera sauce, quail egg and chimichurri.

dishes.name: Salmon Nigiri
dishes.description: Salmon, black tobiko, spicy mayo, sushi rice.

dishes.name: Tuna Wantaco
dishes.description: Wonton tacos, tuna tartare, avocado mousse, chalaca, soy sauce, sesame oil, acevichado sauce and sesame seeds, black tobiko, togarashi.

dishes.name: Papa a la Huancaina
dishes.description: Steamed potatoes, creamy aji amarillo and cheese sauce, quail egg, botija olives, Andean purple potato paper.

dishes.name: Anticuchos de Corazon
dishes.description: Veal heart skewers grilled in an anticuchera sauce, golden potatoes, choclo and chimichurri.

dishes.name: Causa Limeña
dishes.description: Potato dough, aji amarillo, lime, chicken salad, cherry tomato brule, rocoto aioli, radish, onion ash, avocado.

dishes.name: Jalea
dishes.description: Fried fish tempura, shrimp, octopus, calamari, mussels, yuca charcoals, tartar sauce, chalaca, cherry tomato brule.

dishes.name: Ceviche Manka
dishes.description: Mahi Mahi, octopus, shrimp, lime, rocoto tiger's milk, chulpi, choclo, sweet potato brulé, yuyo, red onion and cilantro.

dishes.name: Ceviche Clásico
dishes.description: Mahi Mahi, classic tiger's milk, chulpi, choclo, habanero, cilantro, sweet potato brulé, red onion and rocoto gel.

dishes.name: Ceviche Carretillero
dishes.description: Mahi Mahi, fried calamari, lime, aji amarillo tiger's milk, chulpi, choclo, red onion, sweet potato mousse, cilantro oil, achiote oil.

dishes.name: Vegan "Ceviche"
dishes.description: Oyster and Portobello mushrooms, artichoke tiger's milk, sweet potato, rocoto gel, cilantro oil, choclo, chalaca.
